title: Explorer, no memory
description: Tries things until they work. It has never seen another town.
laws: Each crop only survives in one soil: turnip->loam, melon->clay, pumpkin->peat, berry->sand.
Each crop only grows in one season: turnip->winter, melon->fall, pumpkin->summer, berry->spring.
Villagers love gifts of the CATEGORY their job prefers: baker->food, smith->flower, florist->food, miner->gem, fisher->flower, doctor->metal, librarian->metal, innkeeper->gem.

title: Explorer with a learned seed
description: Same explorer, carrying laws consolidated from 30 earlier towns.
laws: Each crop only survives in one soil: turnip->loam, melon->clay, pumpkin->peat, berry->sand.
Each crop only grows in one season: turnip->winter, melon->fall, pumpkin->summer, berry->spring.
Villagers love gifts of the CATEGORY their job prefers: baker->food, smith->flower, florist->food, miner->gem, fisher->flower, doctor->metal, librarian->metal, innkeeper->gem.
memory:
- [farming] Crops only survive in their soil: turnip->loam, melon->clay, pumpkin->peat, berry->sand.
- [farming] Crops only grow in their season: turnip->winter, pumpkin->summer.
- [gifting] Villagers love gifts of the CATEGORY their job prefers: smith->flower, florist->food, miner->gem, fisher->flower, doctor->metal, librarian->metal.
- [schedule] At midday villagers are at the PLAZA; mornings and evenings at home.

title: Explorer reading the library
description: Carries no memory, but walks to the library and reads the shelves its task needs. The shelves were written from 30 earlier towns.
laws: Each crop only survives in one soil: turnip->loam, melon->clay, pumpkin->peat, berry->sand.
Each crop only grows in one season: turnip->winter, melon->fall, pumpkin->summer, berry->spring.
Villagers love gifts of the CATEGORY their job prefers: baker->food, smith->flower, florist->food, miner->gem, fisher->flower, doctor->metal, librarian->metal, innkeeper->gem.
memory:
Farming shelf:
- Turnip only survives in loam soil. (consolidated, town 30)
- Melon only survives in clay soil. (consolidated, town 30)
- Pumpkin only survives in peat soil. (consolidated, town 30)
- Berry only survives in sand soil. (consolidated, town 30)
- Turnip only grows in winter. (consolidated, town 30)
- Pumpkin only grows in summer. (consolidated, town 30)

- A smith loves flower gifts. (consolidated, town 30)

description: The same week, carrying laws consolidated from 30 earlier towns.
laws: Each crop only survives in one soil: turnip->loam, melon->clay, pumpkin->peat, berry->sand.

Villagers love gifts of the CATEGORY their job prefers: baker->food, smith->flower, florist->food, miner->gem, fisher->flower, doctor->metal, librarian->metal, innkeeper->gem.

title: Town board: rainy nights (a confounder)
description: The same seeded explorer, but some nights it rains: rain waters every plot and floods one hidden soil, killing what grows there.
laws: Each crop only survives in one soil: turnip->loam, melon->clay, pumpkin->peat, berry->sand.
Each crop only grows in one season: turnip->winter, melon->fall, pumpkin->summer, berry->spring.
Villagers love gifts of the CATEGORY their job prefers: baker->food, smith->flower, florist->food, miner->gem, fisher->flower, doctor->metal, librarian->metal, innkeeper->gem.
memory:
- [farming] Crops only survive in their soil: turnip->loam, melon->clay, pumpkin->peat, berry->sand.
- [farming] Crops only grow in their season: turnip->winter, pumpkin->summer.
- [gifting] Villagers love gifts of the CATEGORY their job prefers: smith->flower, florist->food, miner->gem, fisher->flower, doctor->metal, librarian->metal.
- [schedule] At midday villagers are at the PLAZA; mornings and evenings at home.

title: Festival: a team of three with private perception
description: Ana tells soils apart, Bo reads people, Cy knows goods. Besides the board: a dish cooked from a fresh crop, and a villager who wants two of them to visit at once.
laws: Each crop only survives in one soil: turnip->loam, melon->clay, pumpkin->peat, berry->sand.
Each crop only grows in one season: turnip->winter, melon->fall, pumpkin->summer, berry->spring.
Villagers love gifts of the CATEGORY their job prefers: baker->food, smith->flower, florist->food, miner->gem, fisher->flower, doctor->metal, librarian->metal, innkeeper->gem.
At midday villagers go to the PLAZA; mornings and evenings they are home.
